requirement.statement: TuiA1StateGraph SHALL derive all projection signals through the unified DataGraph computed runtime and preserve projection values, updates, and TUI graph behavior.

case.given: the TUI graph has a snapshot and derived projection signals
case.when: the projections are read or snapshot state changes
case.then: their getters SHALL use runtime.graph.get and SHALL NOT use ctx.get
focused TUI graph and integration tests SHALL pass
